notes.title: Patch 2.2

tags.bug: Joh can use the double attack move even though he has no sword equipped. It's fine to use the wrench;
The first meeting with Magdalene does not repeat itself anymore;
Forest south of the Prometheus mountain can no longer be accessed ahead of time, avoiding the bug that makes it impossible to catch the Prometheus summon;

tags.feature: It is now possible to get the Summon Prometheus;

tags.balance_change: Small change in Nilrem's magic (first encounter);

tags.bug: Player cannot proceed without getting into the car in Lorenzo;
Magdalene event crashing the game when it reaches the water fixed;
